name: apple-debug-mcp
description: Debug Apple Simulators from Claude Code: simulator pool with session leases, AXe UI automation, app lifecycle, xctrace profiling, crash symbolication, and an HTTPS intercept proxy. Connects to the shared daemon at 127.0.0.1:3100 over Streamable HTTP — start it first with `apple-debug-mcp launchd create` (SIM_MCP_PORT/SIM_MCP_HOST to change).
